title: Too Big to Neuter
setup: At the concession hearing, Barkington claims only Goodboy can keep the city alive. Refrigeration and clinic power begin failing on schedule.
escalation: The crew must prove sabotage while keeping food safe. Byte correlates signed load-shedding orders with the outages. Onyx and the factory worker lead a physical cold-store transfer; Trixie learns evidence alone cannot replace electricity.
resolution: Neon restores a limited emergency circuit while Ghost obtains the original sabotage authorization. The hearing freezes Goodboy's exclusive concession pending a public vote. Barkington loses the legal shield for the first time.
continuity: Workers and citizens actively save the district; the five heroes do not do everything. The emergency circuit is temporary and cannot sustain the full city.
comedy: Barkington's presentation labels the outage a live demonstration of customer dependence.
ending_hook: Muzzle proposes an old emergency system that can bypass the frozen concession.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
